```{r setup}
library(DT)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(htmltools)
library(jsonlite)

# ── Data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
df <- read.csv("state_distances__raw_and_deltas_.csv", check.names = FALSE)

# ── Constants ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
YEARS       <- 2000:2019
DELTA_YEARS <- 2001:2019

CLUSTER_COLORS <- c("1" = "#B5463A", "2" = "#2E86B5")

# Desaturated versions of cluster colors (for "Colored clusters" fill)
desat_hex <- function(hex, sat_scale = 0.25) {
  rgb_vals <- col2rgb(hex) / 255
  lum      <- 0.2126 * rgb_vals[1] + 0.7152 * rgb_vals[2] + 0.0722 * rgb_vals[3]
  desat    <- lum + sat_scale * (rgb_vals - lum)
  desat    <- pmax(0, pmin(1, desat))
  rgb(desat[1], desat[2], desat[3])
}

CLUSTER_DESAT <- c("1" = desat_hex(CLUSTER_COLORS["1"]),
                   "2" = desat_hex(CLUSTER_COLORS["2"]))

# Bright/light versions for Top-1 bubble
lighten_hex <- function(hex, amount = 0.55) {
  rgb_vals <- col2rgb(hex) / 255
  light    <- rgb_vals + amount * (1 - rgb_vals)
  light    <- pmax(0, pmin(1, light))
  rgb(light[1], light[2], light[3])
}

EXTREMES_CLOSE   <- "#009E73"
EXTREMES_FAR     <- "#D55E00"
EXTREMES_CLOSE_L <- lighten_hex(EXTREMES_CLOSE)
EXTREMES_FAR_L   <- lighten_hex(EXTREMES_FAR)

# ── Helper: extract wide table (states × years) for a given variable prefix ──
extract_wide <- function(prefix, years) {
  cols      <- paste0(prefix, "_", years)
  present   <- cols[cols %in% names(df)]
  out       <- df[, c("state", present), drop = FALSE]
  colnames(out) <- c("State", as.character(years[paste0(prefix, "_", years) %in% names(df)]))
  out
}

# ── Helper: extract cluster assignments wide (state × year) ──────────────────
cluster_wide <- function(years) {
  cols <- paste0("cluster_", years)
  present <- cols[cols %in% names(df)]
  out  <- df[, c("state", present), drop = FALSE]
  colnames(out) <- c("State", as.character(years[paste0("cluster_", years) %in% names(df)]))
  out
}

# ── Helper: build cell-level HTML with coloring ──────────────────────────────
#
# color_mode : "none" | "extremes" | "clusters" | "extremes_top1" |
#              "clusters_top1" | "top1"
# measure    : "global" | "own" | "extremity"
# is_delta   : logical — affects which direction "extreme" means
#
apply_colors <- function(tbl, clust_tbl, color_mode, measure, is_delta, n_top = 3) {

  year_cols <- setdiff(names(tbl), "State")

  # For each year column, compute which rows are "top" / "bottom" / "cluster-top"
  result <- tbl

  for (yr in year_cols) {
    vals    <- tbl[[yr]]
    clust_yr <- if (yr %in% names(clust_tbl)) clust_tbl[[yr]] else NULL

    # ── Determine highlight indices ────────────────────────────────────────────
    # "closest" == smallest value for distances; "most stable delta" == smallest |delta|
    # "furthest" / "most unstable" == largest
    # For ranked cols: smallest rank == closest/best; largest == furthest/worst
    # For extremity: largest == most extreme (furthest), smallest == least extreme

    is_rank <- grepl("^rank_", yr) # not used here but kept for clarity

    if (measure == "own") {
      # Only show closest N per cluster (no "far" side)
      close_idx <- integer(0)
      if (!is.null(clust_yr)) {
        for (cl in unique(na.omit(clust_yr))) {
          in_cl   <- which(clust_yr == cl & !is.na(vals))
          if (length(in_cl) == 0) next
          ranked  <- in_cl[order(vals[in_cl])[seq_len(min(n_top, length(in_cl)))]]
          close_idx <- c(close_idx, ranked)
        }
      }
      far_idx <- integer(0)
      top1_idx <- integer(0)
      if (!is.null(clust_yr)) {
        for (cl in unique(na.omit(clust_yr))) {
          in_cl   <- which(clust_yr == cl & !is.na(vals))
          if (length(in_cl) == 0) next
          top1_idx <- c(top1_idx, in_cl[which.min(vals[in_cl])])
        }
      }

    } else if (measure == "extremity") {
      # "Furthest" = largest extremity value; "closest" not shown for extremes
      # For delta: "most stable" = smallest abs delta
      if (!is_delta) {
        far_idx   <- order(vals, decreasing = TRUE, na.last = NA)[seq_len(n_top)]
        close_idx <- integer(0)
      } else {
        far_idx   <- integer(0)
        close_idx <- order(abs(vals), na.last = NA)[seq_len(n_top)]  # most stable
      }
      top1_idx  <- if (!is_delta) which.max(vals) else which.min(abs(vals))

    } else {
      # measure == "global" (dist_1cs / rank_1cs)
      # closest (smallest) and furthest (largest) each year
      if (!is_delta) {
        close_idx <- order(vals, na.last = NA)[seq_len(n_top)]
        far_idx   <- order(vals, decreasing = TRUE, na.last = NA)[seq_len(n_top)]
      } else {
        # delta: most stable = smallest abs delta; least stable = largest abs delta
        close_idx <- order(abs(vals), na.last = NA)[seq_len(n_top)]
        far_idx   <- order(abs(vals), decreasing = TRUE, na.last = NA)[seq_len(n_top)]
      }
      top1_idx  <- if (!is_delta) which.min(vals) else which.min(abs(vals))
    }

    # ── Build per-cell HTML ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    n        <- nrow(tbl)
    raw_vals <- vals
    disp     <- format(round(vals, 4), nsmall = 4)

    cell_html <- character(n)
    for (i in seq_len(n)) {
      v       <- disp[i]
      cl_i    <- if (!is.null(clust_yr)) as.character(clust_yr[i]) else NA

      # Determine cell background and text-bubble colors
      cell_bg    <- NA_character_
      bubble_col <- NA_character_

      if (color_mode %in% c("clusters", "clusters_top1")) {
        if (!is.na(cl_i) && cl_i %in% names(CLUSTER_DESAT))
          cell_bg <- CLUSTER_DESAT[cl_i]
      }

      if (color_mode %in% c("extremes", "extremes_top1")) {
        if (measure == "own") {
          # Use cluster color for close cells
          if (i %in% close_idx && !is.na(cl_i) && cl_i %in% names(CLUSTER_COLORS))
            cell_bg <- CLUSTER_COLORS[cl_i]
        } else if (measure == "extremity") {
          if (i %in% far_idx)   cell_bg <- EXTREMES_FAR
          if (i %in% close_idx) cell_bg <- EXTREMES_CLOSE
        } else {
          # global
          if (i %in% close_idx) cell_bg <- EXTREMES_CLOSE
          if (i %in% far_idx)   cell_bg <- EXTREMES_FAR
        }
      }

      # Top-1 bubble
      is_top1 <- color_mode %in% c("extremes_top1", "clusters_top1", "top1") &&
                 i %in% top1_idx
      if (is_top1) {
        base_bg    <- if (!is.na(cell_bg)) cell_bg else "#888888"
        bubble_col <- lighten_hex(base_bg, 0.6)
      }

      # Assemble HTML
      style_parts <- character(0)
      if (!is.na(cell_bg))
        style_parts <- c(style_parts,
                         paste0("background-color:", cell_bg, ";"),
                         "color:#111;")

      td_style <- if (length(style_parts)) paste(style_parts, collapse = "") else ""

      if (is_top1) {
        cell_html[i] <- paste0(
          '<div style="', td_style, 'width:100%;height:100%;padding:2px 4px;box-sizing:border-box;">',
          '<span style="background:', bubble_col, ';border-radius:999px;',
          'padding:1px 6px;font-weight:700;">', v, '</span></div>'
        )
      } else if (nchar(td_style) > 0) {
        cell_html[i] <- paste0(
          '<div style="', td_style,
          'width:100%;height:100%;padding:2px 4px;box-sizing:border-box;">', v, '</div>'
        )
      } else {
        cell_html[i] <- v
      }
    }

    result[[yr]] <- cell_html
  }

  result
}

# ── Helper: render one DT ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
make_dt <- function(tbl) {
  datatable(
    tbl,
    escape      = FALSE,
    rownames    = FALSE,
    extensions  = "FixedColumns",
    options     = list(
      pageLength  = 51,
      dom         = "t",
      scrollX     = TRUE,
      fixedColumns = list(leftColumns = 1),
      columnDefs  = list(
        list(className = "dt-right", targets = "_all"),
        list(className = "dt-left",  targets = 0),
        list(width = "52px", targets = seq_len(ncol(tbl) - 1))
      ),
      initComplete = JS(
        "function(settings, json) {",
        "  $(this.api().table().node()).css('font-size','12px');",
        "}"
      )
    ),
    class = "compact hover"
  )
}

# ── Pre-compute all 11 data slices ────────────────────────────────────────────
# (measure × transform combos; cluster-centroid ranked-delta is invalid)
#
# Naming: measure ∈ {global, own, extremity}
#         transform ∈ {raw, raw_delta, ranked, ranked_delta}

slices <- list(
  global_raw          = list(tbl = extract_wide("dist_1cs",          YEARS),       measure = "global",   is_delta = FALSE),
  global_raw_delta    = list(tbl = extract_wide("dist_1cs_delta",     DELTA_YEARS), measure = "global",   is_delta = TRUE),
  global_ranked       = list(tbl = extract_wide("rank_1cs",           YEARS),       measure = "global",   is_delta = FALSE),
  global_ranked_delta = list(tbl = extract_wide("rank_1cs_delta",     DELTA_YEARS), measure = "global",   is_delta = TRUE),
  own_raw             = list(tbl = extract_wide("dist_own",           YEARS),       measure = "own",      is_delta = FALSE),
  own_raw_delta       = list(tbl = extract_wide("dist_own_delta",     DELTA_YEARS), measure = "own",      is_delta = TRUE),
  own_ranked          = list(tbl = extract_wide("rank_own",           YEARS),       measure = "own",      is_delta = FALSE),
  # own_ranked_delta = INVALID (no rank_own_delta in data)
  ext_raw             = list(tbl = extract_wide("extremity",          YEARS),       measure = "extremity", is_delta = FALSE),
  ext_raw_delta       = list(tbl = extract_wide("extremity_delta",    DELTA_YEARS), measure = "extremity", is_delta = TRUE),
  ext_ranked          = list(tbl = extract_wide("rank_extremity",     YEARS),       measure = "extremity", is_delta = FALSE),
  ext_ranked_delta    = list(tbl = extract_wide("rank_extremity_delta", DELTA_YEARS), measure = "extremity", is_delta = TRUE)
)

clust_tbl_all <- cluster_wide(YEARS)

# ── Subtitle lookup ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
subtitle1 <- list(
  global    = "Proximity to the global centroid: Euclidean distance of each state from the overall centroid across all states and years.",
  own       = "Proximity to cluster centroid: Euclidean distance of each state from the centroid of its assigned cluster.",
  extremity = "Extremity: How far each state sits from the centre of the full distribution — a measure of uniqueness."
)

subtitle2 <- list(
  none           = "",
  extremes       = "Extremes highlighted: the 3 closest and 3 furthest states each year are filled.",
  extremes_top1  = "Extremes highlighted + Top 1: extremes filled; the single closest/most-stable state carries a text bubble.",
  clusters       = "Cluster membership highlighted: cell fill shows each state\u2019s cluster (desaturated).",
  clusters_top1  = "Cluster membership + Top 1: cluster fills applied; the closest state per cluster per year carries a text bubble.",
  top1           = "Top 1: the single closest (or most stable) state each year carries a text bubble."
)

subtitle2_own <- list(
  none           = "",
  extremes       = "Extremes highlighted: the 3 closest states per cluster each year are filled using the cluster\u2019s color.",
  extremes_top1  = "Extremes + Top 1: closest 3 per cluster filled; closest 1 per cluster carries a text bubble.",
  clusters       = "Cluster membership highlighted: cell fill shows each state\u2019s cluster (desaturated).",
  clusters_top1  = "Cluster membership + Top 1: cluster fills applied; the closest state per cluster per year carries a text bubble.",
  top1           = "Top 1: the single closest state per cluster per year carries a text bubble."
)

subtitle2_extremity <- list(
  none           = "",
  extremes       = "Extremes highlighted: the 3 most extreme (furthest) states each year are filled.",
  extremes_top1  = "Extremes + Top 1: top 3 most extreme filled; the single most extreme state carries a text bubble.",
  clusters       = "Cluster membership highlighted: cell fill shows each state\u2019s cluster (desaturated).",
  clusters_top1  = "Cluster membership + Top 1: cluster fills applied; the single most extreme state carries a text bubble.",
  top1           = "Top 1: the single most extreme state each year carries a text bubble."
)
```

```{r prerender, results='asis'}
# ── Pre-render all table HTML strings into a named JS object ──────────────────
# Key format: "measure__transform__color"
# This avoids any server-side R calls after page load.

MEASURES    <- c("global", "own", "extremity")
TRANSFORMS  <- c("raw", "raw_delta", "ranked", "ranked_delta")
COLOR_MODES <- c("none", "clusters", "extremes", "top1", "clusters_top1", "extremes_top1")

# Invalid combo: own + ranked_delta
is_invalid <- function(measure, transform)
  measure == "own" && transform == "ranked_delta"

slice_key <- function(measure, transform) {
  paste(measure, transform, sep = "_")
}

# Build per-slice cluster tables aligned by state order
build_clust_aligned <- function(tbl_states, years) {
  # only keep years present in tbl
  yr_cols <- intersect(as.character(years), names(clust_tbl_all))
  ct <- clust_tbl_all[match(tbl_states, clust_tbl_all$State), c("State", yr_cols)]
  ct
}

cat("<script>\nconst TABLES = {};\n")

for (measure in MEASURES) {
  for (transform in TRANSFORMS) {
    if (is_invalid(measure, transform)) next

    sk  <- slice_key(measure, transform)
    sl  <- slices[[sk]]
    if (is.null(sl)) next

    tbl <- sl$tbl

    # Align cluster table to this slice's state order and years
    yr_cols <- setdiff(names(tbl), "State")
    ct <- build_clust_aligned(tbl$State,
                              as.integer(yr_cols[yr_cols %in% names(clust_tbl_all)]))

    for (color_mode in COLOR_MODES) {
      key <- paste(measure, transform, color_mode, sep = "__")

      colored_tbl <- apply_colors(
        tbl        = tbl,
        clust_tbl  = ct,
        color_mode = color_mode,
        measure    = measure,
        is_delta   = sl$is_delta
      )

      dt_widget   <- make_dt(colored_tbl)
      html_str    <- as.character(tagList(dt_widget))
      # Escape for JS string embedding
      html_escaped <- gsub("\\\\", "\\\\\\\\", html_str)
      html_escaped <- gsub("`",    "\\\\`",    html_escaped)
      html_escaped <- gsub("\\$",  "\\\\$",    html_escaped)

      cat(sprintf("TABLES[%s] = `%s`;\n",
                  toJSON(key, auto_unbox = TRUE),
                  html_escaped))
    }
  }
}

# Subtitles
cat("const SUB1 = ", toJSON(subtitle1, auto_unbox = TRUE), ";\n")
cat("const SUB2 = ", toJSON(subtitle2, auto_unbox = TRUE), ";\n")
cat("const SUB2_OWN = ", toJSON(subtitle2_own, auto_unbox = TRUE), ";\n")
cat("const SUB2_EXT = ", toJSON(subtitle2_extremity, auto_unbox = TRUE), ";\n")
cat("</script>\n")
```

```{=html}
<script>
// ── State ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
let curMeasure   = "global";
let curTransform = "raw";
let curColor     = "none";

// ── Setters ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function setMeasure(btn) {
  curMeasure = btn.dataset.measure;
  document.querySelectorAll("#row-measure .ctrl-btn")
    .forEach(b => b.classList.toggle("active", b === btn));
  enforceConstraints();
  render();
}

function setTransform(btn) {
  if (btn.classList.contains("disabled")) return;
  curTransform = btn.dataset.transform;
  document.querySelectorAll("#row-transform .ctrl-btn")
    .forEach(b => b.classList.toggle("active", b === btn));
  render();
}

function setColor(btn) {
  curColor = btn.dataset.color;
  document.querySelectorAll("#row-color .ctrl-btn")
    .forEach(b => b.classList.toggle("active", b === btn));
  render();
}

// ── Constraints ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// "own" measure cannot use "ranked_delta" transform → disable that button
function enforceConstraints() {
  const rdBtn = document.querySelector('[data-transform="ranked_delta"]');
  if (curMeasure === "own") {
    rdBtn.classList.add("disabled");
    // If currently on ranked_delta, fall back to raw_delta
    if (curTransform === "ranked_delta") {
      curTransform = "raw_delta";
      document.querySelectorAll("#row-transform .ctrl-btn")
        .forEach(b => b.classList.toggle("active",
                       b.dataset.transform === curTransform));
    }
  } else {
    rdBtn.classList.remove("disabled");
  }
}

// ── Render ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function render() {
  const key = curMeasure + "__" + curTransform + "__" + curColor;
  const html = TABLES[key];

  // Subtitles
  document.getElementById("sub1").textContent = SUB1[curMeasure] || "";
  const s2map = curMeasure === "own"       ? SUB2_OWN :
                curMeasure === "extremity" ? SUB2_EXT : SUB2;
  document.getElementById("sub2").textContent = s2map[curColor] || "";

  const wrapper = document.getElementById("tbl-wrapper");
  if (!html) {
    wrapper.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#c00;padding:1rem;">Table not available for this combination.</p>';
    return;
  }
  wrapper.innerHTML = html;

  // Re-initialise DataTables (DT drops its JS on first inject; re-run it)
  if (window.HTMLWidgets) {
    HTMLWidgets.staticRender();
  }
}

// ── Init ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  enforceConstraints();
  render();
});
</script>
```
